en.headline: Hospital Authority clarifies $250 diabetes fee is for personalised treatment
en.dek: The authority said the charge is not an admission fee for a talk but covers clinical assessment, personalised dietary advice and follow-up under the gazetted fee schedule.
body: The Hospital Authority on Saturday clarified that a $250 fee charged to some diabetic patients is for personalised treatment services rather than an admission charge for a health talk, following a social-media post that alleged overcharging.

A spokesperson said personalised treatment forms part of clinical services. The Authority provides it according to patients’ clinical needs and charges in line with the fee schedule published in the Government Gazette. There is no overcharging, the spokesman stated.

Most health-education talks and activities organised by hospital patient resource centres are free and open to patients, carers and the public. However, when a doctor refers a diabetic patient to an allied-health clinic, such as for dietetic services, the process may begin with a talk that supplies essential dietary knowledge. Immediately afterwards a dietitian conducts an individual clinical assessment, prepares a personalised plan and continues follow-up. The $250 is the standard charge for each such follow-up consultation.

Similar personalised services are also offered at diabetes nurse clinics and family-medicine clinics, covering assessment, exercise and weight management. The Authority emphasised that the talk is only the first step in a package of clinical care.

zh.headline: 醫管局澄清糖尿病250元屬個人化治療收費 非講座入場費
zh.dek: 局方指收費按政府憲報標準，涵蓋臨床評估、個人化飲食建議及跟進，絕大部分一般健康教育講座均免費。
body: 醫院管理局周六就社交媒體帖文澄清，部分糖尿科病人被收取的250元並非「聽講座」入場費，而是個人化治療服務的收費。
發言人表示，個人化治療屬臨床服務一部分，醫管局按病人臨床需要提供服務，並按照政府憲報刊載的收費表收費，絕不存在濫收費用。
由醫院病人資源中心舉辦的一般健康教育講座及病友活動，供病人、照顧者及公眾參加，全部免費。至於經醫生轉介至專職醫療診所（例如營養服務）的個人化治療，病人會先出席講座掌握必須飲食知識，隨即由營養師面見進行臨床評估、制定個人化建議，並持續跟進病情。250元為每次覆診的標準收費。
糖尿科護士診所及家庭醫學診所亦提供類似個人化治療，涵蓋評估、運動及體重管理等，過程同樣可能安排講座。醫管局強調講座只是整個治療流程的第一環。
